progress.label: B/X public demonstration gates
progress.basis: Recorded public fixtures: dungeon turns, lighting and resources, wandering contact, surprise, observed identities and encounter withdrawal. Remaining: live combat, connected AI referee and full adventure play.
progress.note: These are scoped demonstration gates, not completion of the full B/X ruleset.

roadmap.label: Full approved B/X RPG delivery roadmap
roadmap.scope: Bounded B/X Moldvay/Cook source-faithful conversational RPG release: legal exploration, encounters, spells, characters, integrated AI referee and complete play. It is not the Known World BECMI implementation.
roadmap.note: Weighted, accepted-gates-only planning progress; partial gates earn zero until accepted. Existing milestone/phase percentage is separately preserved.

gates.label: Source-faithful B/X deterministic engine and save migration
